title: Exploring and Mitigating Adversarial Manipulation of Voting-Based Leaderboards

layout.note: Three unframed cartoon scenes left to right with a Step N caption for each along the bottom edge: a hub (arena box between four robots above and five users below), two response cards above a normal and an adversarial user, and two leaderboard tables side by side.

lesson: Stage an attack as captioned cartoon scenes: thin grey lines for every possible link and thick colour lines for the ones used, one reserved colour (red) for the adversary on icon, label and text, and a before / after table at the end to show the damage.
